reviews.x: My daughter is obsessed with headbands and loves these.  They have held up well and we even purchased two more sets

reviews.t: Beautiful bows but fall off easily
reviews.x: These bows are really beautiful. My 3 year old decided she wants her hair down all the time so this was my compromise. I still get cute bows, and she has a say in how her hair is fixed. My only complaint is they don't stay in her hair very well. The ribbon is slippery and the headbands slide off easily. I added small lines of hot glue on the inside of the band. The glue can't be seen when the headbands are on but really seems to hold them in place better. Overall, I'm very happy with this purcha

reviews.t: Caution!! Choking & strangulation hazard... cute but VERY brittle plastic. Not worth it for 2yo
reviews.x: The plastic headband inside of the ribbon wrapping is VERY brittle, so even after very light use and when taking extra care after reading the other reviews, the only 4 colors I've used are broken after 1 to 2 wears. And I mean just bending them enough to gently place on my daughter's head. Two of them sent small, sharp shards of plastic flying when they snapped, then the ribbon unwrapped in a long strand, so these are definitely a choking AND strangulation hazard. Great quality headband for my 2 year old

I can't say enough about these headbands! I have two toddler girls and love using color coordinating bows with their daily fashion. I wanted to incorporate more headbands into the mix with them being a little older (4T / 5T) and more likely to leave them in their hair. These were exactly as I had hoped! Incredibly adorable, well made, and pain-free. The girls and I love them and will definitely be purchasing for them again! Highly recommend.

So glad I ordered these for my girls! They are ages 4 & 5. One has curly hair so the headbands stay in well, the other has very fine hair, so they slip off sometimes. A helpful tip if you have that problem as well just ad about 10 tiny drops hot of glue along the inside. Obviously wait until it dries before putting it on Lol. These don't look cheap at all and really are the perfect size for little girls.
I absolutely loved them!  I wish they had more colors in this style, would buy them in a heartbeat!
I absolutely loved them!  I wish they had more colors in this style, would buy them in a heartbeat!

-Came as pictured and packaged well. -Headband portion is covered in ribbon, making it comfortable against the head. -Bow is a good size for toddlers. They fit my three year old well, and I'd say she could wear it at least several more years. -We've only been using them a couple of weeks, but it seems they are good quality and I expect them to hold up well.

These are SO CUTE! You can wear the bow flat or pouf it up. It's a great set that comes in a variety of colors which is perfect for my daughter who goes through many different outfits. Can be dressy or casual. These are well made and comfortable for her to wear all day without complaint. They came in great shape, just as described!  Update: Its been over a year (and plenty of wear) since I’ve purchased these and not one has broke.great quality and my daughters still love wearing them!

reviews.t: These are super cute on my 2 year old
reviews.x: These are super cute on my 2 year old! They fit well and she loves to wear them. They don’t seem to bother her so they must be comfortable. We’ve had them for about 2 months with use about 4 times per week. They’re all holding up perfect except for the red one which unraveled and I couldn’t get it back on right to fix it, which is why I’m deducting one star

LOVE these headbands!!  They look so sweet on........they appear to be comfortable........my daughter wears them all day with no fuss!!!!  After receiving the first set I ordered - I immediately ordered a second set with other colors!!!!

These are so cute. We have had them for a year and they are going strong. My now 2 year old puts them on herself. She also makes mommy, Daddy and Auntie wear them on occasion and they are confortable no matter how big your head is lol.

reviews.t: Adorable and Awesome Granddaughters say these are "Awesome and Adorable" ...
reviews.x: Adorable and Awesome Granddaughters say these are "Awesome and Adorable" (they are 5 and 7) and the colors are excellent plus I was afraid the flower bows would be smashed or wrinkled -but they were perfect!

reviews.t: Great for 3 year old. Good qualify super cute.
reviews.x: My 3 year old loves these. Thought the bow would be too big but they’re the perfect size. They slip a little on her small head but she loves them. Good quality especially for the price. Would buy again.
Absolutely loved this for my one year old they are beautiful and go with any outfit! Will be buying more in different colors!
So cute and good quality. They don't feel or look cheap, they don't squeeze my daughters head nor do they slide off easily.
My 4 year old loves these. On our second set, a few snapped after about 6 months when she tried to wear as a belt.
Looks very nice. I don't think they're made that well though. After about 3 wears one is unraveling.
Pretty and well made. Definitely get if you are looking for a classy bow. Fits my 2 year old.
These worked great. We have only worn the black one but the others will be worn soon.

reviews.t: Look nice but don’t stay on.
reviews.x: They look nice but do not stay on. They have no teeth and aren’t tight/strong enough.
Cute & great colors. A bit large for my 4yr old but still very cute.

My daughter was really excited for these headbands -- the colors were beautiful (and it's the same color as shown on pictures) and matches so many attire. However they were a little too big for her. my daughter is 4 and her head is above average size and a little more elongated face shape. the headband kept slipping off from her head. Nice little headbands.  No teeth on underside so slip around a bit but that’s what I expected.  The band is flexible plastic which makes them easily broken but also makes it more comfortable for my daughter to wear so less of a fight when getting ready for school.  Limited product life but comfortable to wear so overall I would buy these again.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the headbands as cute, beautiful, or adorable.
Many reviewers praise the quality, durability, and value for the price.
Several reviewers note the headbands slip off or don't stay in hair well, especially with fine hair.
Some reviewers report the headbands are brittle and break easily.
Reviewers commonly mention the headbands are comfortable for children to wear.
